'''Tribe Rebellion''' was a phrase that was used by the [[Panshee]] tribe of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] to refer to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="EBB">{{JournalCite|1|Escape from Balis-Baurgh}}</ref>
